card.name: Prohibited handling after "do not"
card.fires_on: The verb or adverb right after a prohibition such as "Do not", "must not be" or "must never be", most often "freeze" in storage instructions. It also fires on route words like "subcutaneously" and "administration" in warnings.

modes.label: Rule-breaking outcome
modes.description: A verb in a non-drug rule statement that says what happens when the rule is broken.
modes.example: all subsequent entries<< will>> be disqualified.

card.writes: It adds a sense that a prohibited or invalid outcome follows, which fits words like 'unreliable' and '无效' (invalid).
card.plain: It responds to the word that completes a warning not to do something, such as not to freeze a product.
